notes.title: Am I Dropping Bombs Or...
notes.content:
Let's just be totally honest here y'all - I've been an asshat. I mean I came to drop bombs and I just ended up dropping the ball.
Someone also thought I died too, so I'll even throw that one in for free.

Apologies my friends. As a solo dev with a real life ♥♥♥♥♥♥ job and mouths to feed, life got in the way. Not an excuse, just an explanation. If y'all have under 2 hours gameplay feel free to refund and I'll even send you a key if you decide you're still feelin' the burn. Dad jokes. Anyway, things are slowing down and speeding up. I'm going to do my best to uphold my promise to keep this updated. Better late than never? No? Okay, I'm an asshat.

notes.title: Road Map Insight and a Thanks to All Who Have Bought the Game!
notes.content:
Now that GHOST AC-130 is released I wanted to first thank the community for purchasing it. I'm honored that all of you have bought it and I want you to know that I am not going to abandon this project. As promised, there will be 3 campaign levels and more in-game mechanics and score keeping variables coming soon. Of course I can't give an absolute date, but being that this game is only being developed by me, I can much better forecast what I need to deliver and how capable I am of delivering it within a period of time. Right now I am hoping to be out of Early Access in the next 3 months. For those of you who have bought the game already, this is going to be access to content that you have already paid for at $3.99. Any updates or content added will always be free - no priced DLC (even if it is DLC). 

When the game is in full release with all campaign missions and added mechanics integrated i will be pricing the game at $6.99. 

Thanks again for purchasing the game and any and all questions and/or suggestions are welcome in the forums here, or at my email - ghostc130game@gmail.com.

Cheers!
